policy: All five families receive up to 5.6 allocation GPU-hours of the 28-hour screening budget. These are caps, not promises to spend on failed methods. Profile first. Include infrastructure failures in actual cost. Expand a boundary optimum before a superiority claim, using remaining family budget; if it cannot be bracketed, report insufficient tuning. Retain the full published Muon anchor regardless of short-screen ranking.
promotion: Correct and finite updates; promising development PPL at equal tokens; then repeat seed43 and full3250-step horizon. Verify mechanism against parent/control and retune strongest baseline. No holdout access during selection.
known_prior: soft_polar is a SoftMuon-family comparison, not a novel spectral map; shampoo_shrink is the finite-sample regularization hypothesis. TCD1 is deprioritized after its separately archived adverse screen.
